design: Within region and ZT: ~ phenotype; three groups, three explicit contrasts
normalization: DESeq2 median ratios across included samples within region; same factors supplied to each stratum
filter: Any phenotype median raw count >= 10 within stratum
go_method: One-sided hypergeometric overrepresentation; BH across all eligible BP terms (10â€“500 background genes) per contrast; GOALL ancestor memberships
go_universe: GO BP-mapped genes with finite padj in that contrast
go_thresholds: Fixed padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 0.5; does not change with exploration controls
source_commit_note: Validated implementation snapshot used for this analysis and site; subsequent commits may add deployment evidence.
